name: brand-identity
body:
kalide has a documented visual identity, currently absent from the repo (no brand directory or brand SVG exists today). Mark: the user-supplied faceted-hexagon logo SVG (a hexagon with facet lines and an orange triangular facet), used as-is apart from splitting and recolouring. It is split into two files: `brand/logo_dark.svg`, the dark-filled hexagon tile for dark backgrounds / dark mode, and `brand/logo_light.svg`, the light-filled tile for light backgrounds. Source, split/crop recipe and recolour map are in solution.note.brand-mark-source. The mark was designed to stay legible down to 16px; no PNG exports are required for 0.5.0. Wordmark: the word "kalide" in lowercase Helvetica, used as text in documentation (e.g. README), not as an asset file. Palette (from the brand board, canonical): "the void" `#0F1115`, "the structure" `#F8F9FA`, "the enforcer" `#FF5722`.

It lives as plain repository files under the repo-root `brand/` directory, referenced only from documentation and marketing surfaces — README hero image, package-channel (Homebrew/Scoop) descriptions, an optional GitHub social-preview image — never embedded in the binary. The brand is all rights reserved, not Apache-2.0: `brand/LICENSE` reads "Copyright © Really Knows AI. All rights reserved." plus the statement that "kalide" and the kalide logo are trademarks of Really Knows AI and are not licensed under Apache-2.0. A repo-root `TRADEMARKS.md` gives a short permitted-use policy: anyone may refer to kalide by name and use the unmodified logo to link to or refer to the project; no one may use the name or logo for forks or derived products, use modified logos, or use them in a way implying endorsement.

AC: `brand/logo_dark.svg` and `brand/logo_light.svg` both exist and are derived from the supplied source (same path geometry and transforms, dark and light tile respectively). Each has a square viewBox tightly framing its one tile and uses only the three palette colours. `brand/LICENSE` exists with the all-rights-reserved and trademark statements. `TRADEMARKS.md` exists at the repo root with the permitted-use policy above. No file under `internal/assets` or any `go:embed` directive references the brand files.
